title: Phase 1 - L2 Browser Client Foundation
summary: Foundation brief for a standalone Babylon.js + strict TypeScript browser client with a synthetic demo, its requirements, and scope boundary.
notes: MANIFEST_TYPE PRD applied (manifest_override). Content signals: requirements, acceptance checks, verification and handoff, scope boundary; no user stories or Status field. Owner/work-order statements recorded: (1) Foundation: "Start with Babylon.js Editor v5's native Vanilla template." (2) Foundation: "Use pnpm exclusively, pin its version and commit pnpm-lock.yaml. Do not generate npm or yarn lockfiles." (3) Foundation: "Treat linegen as read-only: never modify or deploy it, or run its server, lab or database commands." (4) Implementation: "Use procedural animated placeholders when licensed GLB assets are unavailable." (5) Verification and handoff: "Commit and push the completed implementation only to logingrupa/l2-browser-client." (6) Scope boundary: "Exclude Mobius networking, Interlude packets, WebSocket relay, SpacetimeDB, gacha, real combat calculations, quests, progression, original L2 map conversion and production deployment." (7) Scope boundary: "Future step 2, context only: Real M0 networking" (later step, not Phase 1). Preamble states the implementation was pushed in commit 3b16f1c317e20ee636a3b3f83bddafc15096740a and this brief is retained for history. No dated decisions found.
